desc: Prove that an optimum can be restricted to a reduced adjacent-swap sequence and that the stable-insertion reduced word is minimum under increasing edge costs.
Derive the insertion contribution using the rank of each P_i among P_1..P_i.
Design and implement the O(N log N) Fenwick-tree solution with 64-bit-safe arithmetic.
Validate the formula against reverse, sorted, samples, and small exhaustive shortest-path cases.
